provenance.postgres_version: PostgreSQL 17.6 on aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu, compiled by gcc (GCC) 13.2.0, 64-bit
provenance.query: select current_timestamp as captured_at, version() as postgres_version, (select max(version) from supabase_migrations.schema_migrations) as latest_migration, jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('schema', n.nspname, 'relation', c.relname, 'kind', c.relkind, 'columns', (select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('name', a.attname, 'ordinal', a.attnum, 'type', pg_catalog.format_type(a.atttypid,a.atttypmod), 'nullable', not a.attnotnull) order by a.attnum) from pg_attribute a where a.attrelid=c.oid and a.attnum>0 and not a.attisdropped)) order by c.relname) as inventory from pg_class c join pg_namespace n on n.oid=c.relnamespace where n.nspname='public' and c.relkind in ('r','p','v','m','f') and (c.relname in ('donors','donations','donor_pledges','missionaries','profiles','receipts','gift_receipt_records','contribution_receipt_snapshots') or c.relname like '%care%');
